David, I just talked to the manager of Benton Department Store.
There's been a change, so the grand opening of their new location will now be on April 10th, not April 3rd.
But we've already printed more than half of the posters and promotional materials they requested.
I know.
The manager's going to send us the proofs with the new information and agreed to pay for the extra printing work.
But everything needs to be ready by tomorrow.
Well, I thought we wouldn't have much work to do tonight, so Linda's the only one scheduled to come in.
Okay, I'll start making some calls.

David，我刚和 Benton Department Store 的经理谈过话。
发生了一些变化，所以他们新店的开幕式现在定在 4 月 10 日，而不是 4 月 3 日。
但我们已经印了他们要求的半数以上的海报和宣传材料。
我知道。
这位经理会把带有新信息的样稿发给我们，并同意支付额外的印刷费用。
但是所有东西都必须在明天准备好。
嗯，我以为今晚我们不会有太多工作要做，所以 Linda 是唯一安排来上班的人。
好的，我开始打电话了。
